# montecarlo_custom_connector_type (Data Source)

A custom connector type is an integration one of your collection agents registered for your account. Use its id as the connection type of self-hosted credentials, and create its warehouse, ETL container or BI container on its deployment.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `custom_connector_type_id` (String) Id of the custom connector type, as returned when it is listed.

### Read-Only

- `asset_class` (String) What the connector connects to: a warehouse, an ETL tool or a BI tool.
- `capabilities` (Attributes) What the connector supports. Set only for a warehouse connector. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--capabilities))
- `collection_agent_id` (String) The collection agent that registered the connector. It may name an agent the collection agents endpoints no longer list.
- `created_time` (String) When the connector type was first registered.
- `deployment_id` (String) The deployment of the collection agent that registered the connector. Its connections run there. The id may name a deployment the deployments endpoints do not list.
- `icon_url` (String) Icon for the connector. Supplied by the collection agent, not validated, and never fetched by Monte Carlo. Null for a warehouse connector, or when none was supplied.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the custom connector type, used as a connection type.
- `job_types` (List of String) The collection jobs the connector runs.
- `name` (String) Display name of the connector. Supplied by the collection agent that registered it, and not validated.
- `terminology` (Attributes) The connector's nouns for its tiers. Set only for an ETL connector. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--terminology))
- `updated_time` (String) When the connector type was last registered.

Read-Only:

- `supports_agent_monitor` (Boolean) Whether the connector supports agent monitors.
- `supports_agent_trajectory_monitor` (Boolean) Whether the connector supports agent trajectory monitors.

- `supports_custom_sql_monitor` (Boolean) Whether the connector supports custom SQL monitors.
- `supports_field_lineage` (Boolean) Whether the connector supports field-level lineage.
- `supports_freshness` (Boolean) Whether the connector supports freshness monitoring.
- `supports_full_query_language` (Boolean) Whether the connector supports the full query language.
- `supports_json_schema_monitor` (Boolean) Whether the connector supports JSON schema monitors.
- `supports_lineage` (Boolean) Whether the connector supports lineage extraction.
- `supports_metadata` (Boolean) Whether the connector supports metadata collection.
- `supports_metric_monitors_on_unknown_types` (Boolean) Whether the connector supports metric monitors on unknown field types.
- `supports_non_metadata_size_collection` (Boolean) Whether the connector supports size collection without metadata.
- `supports_query_logs` (Boolean) Whether the connector supports query log collection.

- `supports_transform` (Boolean) Whether the connector supports transforms.

- `supports_volume_rows` (Boolean) Whether the connector supports row-count volume monitoring.


<a id="nestedatt--terminology"></a>
### Nested Schema for `terminology`

Read-Only:

- `group` (String) Noun for the group tier above jobs. Null if the tool has none.
- `job` (String) Noun for the job tier.
- `task` (String) Noun for the task tier. Null if the tool has none.
